WITH status_rates AS (
  SELECT
    s.healtheval,
    SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scancount,
    AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS gb_per_minute_rate
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s
    ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
with_average AS (
  SELECT
    status_rates.*,
    AVG(gb_per_minute_rate) OVER () AS average_rate_across_statuses
  FROM status_rates
)
SELECT
  healtheval,
  total_scancount,
  gb_per_minute_rate,
  gb_per_minute_rate - average_rate_across_statuses AS rate_minus_average
FROM with_average
WHERE gb_per_minute_rate > average_rate_across_statuses;

assumptions.assumption: A zero scan duration makes that scan's GB-per-minute ratio undefined, so it is excluded from the rate average; SQL also ignores missing ratios and status rates when computing the overall average.
